title: PDV Phase 20 Redguard sect, Far Shores, and make-way implementation costing
designRules: Crown, Forebear, and Ash'abah must remain distinct in play, not only in text.
Death-duty is important but must not swallow Redguard religion into an undead-clearing economy.
HoonDing is rare make-way drama with a cap, not a steady combat buff loop.
Tu'whacca surfaces can use Arkay-adjacent game spaces while remaining explicitly Yokudan.
Werewolf strains Redguard devotion; vampire breaks the cycle until Tu'whacca re-entry.

notes: Forebear is the safe fallback if setup or evidence is ambiguous.
Reuses the skeleton scaffold record already present in the framework ESP.
Switches should require setup or credible world evidence.
Existing skeleton global mirrors the active Redguard sect for records, dialogue conditions, and Survey Devotion.
Portable Tu'whacca devotional surface with no V1 private/home condition.
Tracked as StorageUtil proof texture in the first implementation slice, not as an Arkay shrine replacement.

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Yokudan sect, death duty, and honor shape Redguard worship on Skyrim's roads without becoming generic undead combat.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Crown, Forebear, and Ash'abah rewards express form, adaptation, impurity, and duty as distinct religious postures.
Far Shores and Tu'whacca surfaces use Skyrim death spaces while staying explicitly Yokudan.
feedbackSurface: Sect entry and Survey rows tell the player which posture is active and why.
Far Shores token and marked Ash'abah/make-way copy carry private ritual, burden, and rare drama.
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A Redguard can feel Crown, Forebear, or Ash'abah through road, ritual, duty, and social burden without farming undead or kill counts.
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Before expanding death-duty rewards, prove sect readback, Far Shores private ritual, one non-undead sect reward, and negative cases for generic combat, fast travel, and Arkay replacement.

rules: sect state/readback and survey rows exist before sect rewards ship
